section_title: CITY OF FREMONT / CHARTER ADVISORY COMMITTEE
text: March 23, 2026 5:00 p.m. to 6:30 p.m. City Council Chambers 3300 Capitol Avenue, Building A Fremont, CA MINUTES 1. Call to Order: Assistant City Manager Christina Briggs called the meeting to order at 5:00 p.m. 2. Flag Salute: Committee Member Kim Marshall led the salute to the flag. 3. Roll Call: Dharminder Dewan, Rick Jones, Sue Kwong, Kim Marshall, Sathya Sankaran, and Ben Yee Absent: Brad Hatton 4. Public Comment The following people provided comment: Keith Parker, Colin Ricketts, Kelly Abreu, and Jack Rogers. 5. City Staff Presentation to the Charter Advisory Committee on the following topics: Assistant City Manager Christina Briggs gave a presentation along with City Attorney Rafael Alvarado on the following topics: a. Committee Orientation and Introduction to the Brown Act b. Charter Initiative Background and Approved Workplan c. City of Fremont Government Structure d. Overview of Charter and General Law Structures Staff responded to questions from Committee Members. Committee Members provided comment. 6. Next Meeting: Monday, March 30, 2026 Time: 5:00 to 6:30 p.m. Location: City Council Chambers, 3300 Capitol Avenue, Fremont 7. Adjournment There being no further business, Assistant City Manager Christina Briggs adjourned the meeting at 6:05 p.m. Minutes Fremont Charter Advisory Committee Meeting March 23, 2026
